info.title: TooManyProjects API
info.description: JSON API used by the web app. Every path is under /api/v1.

get.summary: Files, newest first (by when the photo was taken, else when it was added).

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description:
A project's files: its own, its tasks', comments', rows' and those of
notes linked to it.

parameters.name: include_children
parameters.description: With `project_id`: projects spawned from it too, all the way down.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: One task's files, its comments' included.

parameters.name: images_only
parameters.description: Images only.

post.summary:
Add photos or files. The body is `multipart/form-data` with one or more
parts named `file`. Each may be up to the server's limit (25 MB unless
`TMP_MAX_UPLOAD_MB` says otherwise).

parameters.name: comment_id
parameters.description: A comment of yours in a task's log.

delete.summary: Remove a photo or file for good.

get.summary: The file itself, or a preview of an image.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: `400` or `1600` for an image's preview (a JPEG); left out, the original.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: Offer it as a download instead of showing it.

post.summary: Make an account from an invite, and sign in. Public.
Sign in with email and password.
Sign out of this browser.
Create the owner account. Works only once, on an install with no accounts.

get.summary: Whether the install needs setting up, and who is signed in.

Your calendar between two times: sessions on every project you can see,
your own busy time, and who's joining. Repeats come back once per week.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the range, RFC 3339.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range, RFC 3339. At most 62 days after `from`.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Only this project's sessions.

parameters.name: mine
parameters.description: Only what you put in or are joining.

post.summary: Plan a session on a project, or block out busy time.

get.summary: One event, as you see it.

delete.summary: Delete an event, or with `occurrence`, take one week out of a repeat.

parameters.name: occurrence
parameters.description:
On a repeating event, take out only the week starting on this local
date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Leave out to delete every week.

patch.summary: Change an event. On a repeat, every week changes.

put.summary: Say you'll join a session that week. Anyone who can see the project can.

parameters.name: occurrence
parameters.description: Local date, YYYY-MM-DD

delete.summary: Take back saying you'll join.

parameters.name: occurrence
parameters.description: Local date, YYYY-MM-DD

get.summary:
Your home canvas: cards, their positions and the links between them.
Projects without a card yet are placed automatically.

parameters.name: include_archived
parameters.description: Include archived projects. Default false.

post.summary:
Draw a group: a labelled, coloured area behind cards. Dragging it moves
the cards inside. Groups live on your own canvas, so nobody else sees them.

delete.summary: Remove a group. The cards inside stay where they are.

patch.summary:
Rename, recolour, move or resize a group. Moving it here does not move
the cards inside; the canvas sends those in the same drag.
Save card positions after a drag.

delete.summary: Remove a checklist item.

patch.summary: Tick, untick or reword a checklist item.

delete.summary: Delete a comment: your own, or any on a project you own.

get.summary:
Every database you can see, in any project, with its views. For embeds
and pickers.
A database with its columns and views.

delete.summary: Delete a database and every row in it.

post.summary: Add a column at the right.

get.summary:
A database as a zip: `<name>.csv` and `<name>/<row>.md` with the row's
values in front matter.
A database's rows. With `view`, its filters and sorts apply.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Apply this view's filters and sorts.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only rows with this text in any cell.

post.summary: Add a row.
Save a new view.

delete.summary: Remove a column and its values. The name column can't be removed.

patch.summary:
Rename, retype, change the choices of, or move a column. Changing the
type converts the values that fit and clears the rest.

delete.summary: Delete a row.

patch.summary: Change some cells, replace some relations, or move a row.

delete.summary: Remove a view. A database keeps at least one.

patch.summary: Change a view's name, type, filters, sorts, columns, pin or place.

get.summary: Liveness check, used by the Docker health check.
Whether HTTPS is on, and what its certificate covers.

The certificate authority to trust, as a PEM file. Public, like any
certificate, so a phone can fetch it before anyone signs in.

post.summary:
Cover another address with the certificate. The owner only. Anyone who
already trusts the app's authority needn't do anything again.

delete.summary: Stop covering an address added in Settings. The owner only.

post.summary:
Move something from the Inbox into a project: as a task (the note's text
becomes its description, its photos move to the task, and the note goes),
or as a note filed under the project.

get.summary: Settings for the whole install.

patch.summary:
Change settings for the whole install. Owner only. Changing the currency
also changes the Unit cost column of every Parts database.

get.summary: Invites made on this install, newest first. Owner only.

post.summary: Make an invite link. Owner only.

get.summary: Check an invite token before showing the sign-up form. Public.

delete.summary: Cancel an unused invite. Owner only.
Delete a label. Tasks keep everything else.

get.summary:
The title, site name and picture of a web page, for a pasted or shared
link. Only public addresses are fetched, and only the first 512 KB.

post.summary: Draw a link between two projects.

409.description: Duplicate, or would make a loop

delete.summary: Remove a link. The projects stay.

patch.summary: Change a link's kind or label, or swap its direction.

get.summary: The signed-in person.

patch.summary: Save the signed-in person's theme choice.

get.summary: Your notes and those shared with you, newest first, or the best matches for `q`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search over titles and bodies.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: First folder of the path, such as `Inbox`. Your own notes only.

parameters.name: shared
parameters.description:
True: only notes others have shared with you. False: only yours.
Left out: both.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Default 200, at most 500.

post.summary: Write a new note to the vault.

get.summary: Every file in your vault, notes and attachments, as one zip.

post.summary:
Import a zip of markdown files. Notes keep their folders; a note whose
path is taken gets ` 2` added. Hidden folders such as `.obsidian` and
Notion's CSV databases are skipped.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description:
Where the zip came from: `obsidian` (a zipped vault folder) or
`notion` (Export, Markdown & CSV).

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description:
Folder to put everything under, such as `Imported`. Empty means the
vault root.

post.summary: Re-read the vault now, picking up files changed outside the app.

get.summary: Every tag in use, most used first.
One note with its body, backlinks and resolved links.

delete.summary: Delete a note's file for good. Only from your own vault.

patch.summary: Edit a note. A new title renames the file and fixes links to it.

get.summary: The note's file as it is on disk, front matter included.

A file a note embeds, such as `![[photo.jpg]]`, found the way Obsidian
finds it: beside the note, from the vault's top, in `attachments/`, then
anywhere in the vault by name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description:
What the note embeds, as written: `photo.jpg`, `attachments/photo.jpg`
or a path relative to the note.

post.summary: Allow (or cancel) a connection. Returns the address to send the person back to.

get.summary: Apps you've allowed, newest first.

delete.summary: Stop an app at once: its tokens stop working and it leaves the list.

get.summary: What an app is asking for, for the Allow page.

parameters.name: response_type
parameters.description: Must be `code`.

parameters.name: code_challenge
parameters.description: The PKCE challenge: base64url SHA-256 of the app's verifier.

parameters.name: code_challenge_method
parameters.description: Must be `S256`.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: What the app asked for: `read`, `write` or both, space separated.

get.summary: Everyone else with an account here, to share with.
Your projects and the ones shared with you, with their card stats, oldest first.

parameters.name: include_archived
parameters.description: Include archived projects. Default false.

post.summary: Make a project, optionally spawned from another and placed on the canvas.

get.summary: One project with its parents and children.

delete.summary: Delete a project, its tasks and its links for good. Owner only.

patch.summary: Edit a project. Archive it by setting `status` to `archived`.

put.summary: Choose the photo on the project's canvas card.

get.summary: Stat tiles, weekly chart, up next and activity for a project.
A project's databases, in order, each with its views.

post.summary: Make a database with a Name column and an All view.

Make a database from a CSV file, such as a Notion database export. The
first column becomes the name; the others get a type guessed from their
values.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The new database's name. Defaults to "Imported".

get.summary: A project's labels, by name.

post.summary: Make a label for this project's tasks.

get.summary: A project's notes, and other notes that mention it.
Everyone who can see a project, owner first.

What a project has spent on parts and has left to buy, with its family's
total, and its tasks waiting on parts.
A project's board columns, left to right.

post.summary: Add a column: at the right end of the board, or after `after_id`.

get.summary: Every task in a project, column by column.

post.summary: Add a task to a project.
Capture a line as a task, a note filed under a project, or into the Inbox.

get.summary: Everything that matched, kind by kind, best matches first within each.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
The words to look for. Each word matches the start of a word, so
`brak` finds `brakes`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Most results of each kind. Default 8, at most 50.

get.summary: Shares you have made and shares made with you.

post.summary: Share your whole account, or one of your projects, with someone here.

delete.summary:
Stop sharing. The person who shared can remove it, and so can the person
it was shared with, to leave.

patch.summary: Change a share's role or what it takes in. Only the person who shared.

get.summary:
Every part to buy across your projects, grouped by supplier, plus what's on
the way and what arrived this month.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: The viewer's IANA time zone, which says what today and this month are.

post.summary:
Move parts to a stage together, such as ticking parts on the Shopping
list and pressing Mark ordered.

delete.summary: Remove a column. Its tasks must be moved first, with `move_to`.

parameters.name: move_to
parameters.description: Move the column's tasks here first. Needed when it has any.

409.description: Last column, or tasks left in it

patch.summary: Rename, recategorise, recolour or move a column.

get.summary: The running version and whether a newer release is out. Owner only.

post.summary: Checks GitHub for a new release right away. Owner only.

get.summary:
Tasks across every project, for the global board. Archived projects are
left out, and so are tasks finished more than `done_days` ago.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Only this project.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: This project and every project spawned from it, at any depth.

parameters.name: done_days
parameters.description: Hide tasks completed more than this many days ago. Default 14.

parameters.name: mine
parameters.description: Only tasks assigned to you.

get.summary: One task with its checklist and history.

delete.summary: Delete a task.

patch.summary: Edit a task, or move it between columns.

post.summary: Add a checklist item to the bottom of a task's list.
Add a comment to a task's log.

put.summary:
Link a note to a task, so each shows on the other. Needs edit rights on
the task's project and read access to the note. Linking doesn't share the
note: people on the project who can't read it see only that one is linked.

delete.summary: Unlink a note from a task. The note itself is kept.

get.summary:
Rows that link to a task, grouped by database. Databases in the task's
project with a relation column to tasks come back even with no rows yet,
so you can add one.
Every installed theme.
One theme's full token file. See `themes/theme.schema.json` for its shape.
What to touch next, across every project.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description:
The viewer's IANA time zone, such as Europe/London, which says when
today starts. Defaults to the zone they last planned time in.

get.summary: Your tokens, newest first, revoked ones included.

post.summary: Make a token for an AI assistant. The secret is in the reply and nowhere else.

delete.summary: Stop a token working. It stays in the list, marked revoked.

ActivityItem.description: One line of a project's or task's history.

payload.description: Details for the kind, such as the task title or the columns moved between.

host.description: A name such as `nas.local`, or an IP address such as `192.168.1.50`.

state.description: Passed back to the app untouched.

redirect_to.description: Where to send the browser next: back to the app.

can_edit.description: You may caption or remove it.

comment_id.description: Set when it was added with a comment in the task's log.

is_image.description: An image with previews: ask for `?size=400` or `?size=1600`.

name.description:
The file's name. For a note's file, its name in the vault, as used in
an `![[embed]]`.

project_id.description: Missing only for a note's file.

taken_at.description: When the photo was taken, from the camera (local time, no zone).

needs_setup.description: True until the owner account exists. The web app shows setup instead of login.

can_edit.description: You may change or delete it.

kind.description: `session` (time on a project) or `busy` (only you see these).

repeat_days.description: Repeats weekly on these days: bit 0 is Monday, bit 6 Sunday. 0 = once.

repeat_until.description: Last day a repeat may start on, local `YYYY-MM-DD`.

title.description: What the time is for: "Rear brakes", "Work".

user_id.description: Who put it in the calendar.

CanvasView.description: Everything the canvas draws, in one call.

links.description: Links whose ends are both in `projects` or `locked`, at least one in `projects`.

locked.description: Linked projects that aren't shared with you.

projects.description: Your projects and the ones shared with you.

Choice.description: One option of a select or multi-select column.

id.description: Left empty when adding a choice; the server gives it one.

is_title.description: The row's name. Every database has exactly one, and it stays text.

role.description:
What a template column is for, such as `status` or `unit_cost` in a
Parts database. Such a column keeps its type.

choices.description: Select and multi-select: the choices, in order.

currency.description: Currency: an ISO code such as `GBP`.

target_database_id.description: Relation to rows: the database they're in.

attachments.description: Photos and files added with it.

can_delete.description: You wrote it, or you own the project.

can_edit.description: You wrote it and can still change the project.

user_id.description: Missing when the author's account is gone.

attachment_ids.description:
Files you just uploaded to the task, to show with this comment
instead. Only read when adding a comment.

body.description: Markdown, up to 20,000 characters. May be empty when adding photos.

client_name.description: The name the app gave itself, such as "Claude".

redirect_host.description: Where the person goes back to, such as claude.ai.

suggested_scope.description: The access to preselect: `read` when the app asked for read only.

warning.description: Set when the return address looks wrong for the app's name.

redirect_host.description: Where it signed in from, such as claude.ai or localhost.

attachment_id.description: A photo on this project, or `null` for no cover.

template.description: `parts` starts it with the Parts columns and views.

project_id.description: Required for a session; not allowed for busy time.

repeat_days.description: Weekly repeat days, bit 0 Monday to bit 6 Sunday. Default 0 (once).

repeat_until.description: Last day a repeat may start on, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

color.description: A theme slot (slot-1 to slot-8) or #rrggbb. Default slot-1.

label.description: What the area holds, such as "Electronics". Up to 80 characters.

note.description: A reminder of who it is for, shown in the list.

project_id.description: Required for a `project` invite. You must own it.

folder.description:
`inbox`, `knowledge`, or a folder path. Defaults to the first
project's folder when `project_ids` is set, else Knowledge.

task_id.description:
Link the new note to this task (you need to be able to change it).
Without `project_ids` or `folder`, the note is filed under the task's project.

title.description: Defaults to "Untitled" (or the date, for the Inbox).

color.description: Defaults to the next unused-looking slot.

oneOf.description: Where to put the card on your home canvas. Defaults to beside the others.

spawned_from.description: Draw a spawned link from this project to the new one.

after_id.description: Put it after this row; at the end when left out.

relations.description: Relation column id to its links.

project_id.description: Share this project. Leave out to share your whole account.

after_id.description: Where to put it: after this column, or first when `null`. Left out, it goes at the end.

assignee_id.description: Someone who can see the project.

at_top.description: Add at the top of the column instead of the bottom.

status_id.description: Column to add it to. Defaults to the first column.

name.description: What it's for, such as "Claude on my laptop".

token.description: The raw token. It is never shown again.

url.description: The link to send, when the server knows its public URL.

secret.description: Shown once. Only a hash is stored.

activity.description: The latest fifteen things that happened.

columns.description: Every column in board order, with how many tasks sit in it.

up_next.description: Up to five open tasks: late and soonest due first, then by priority.

weekly.description: Tasks finished in each of the last eight weeks, oldest first.

template.description: `parts` for a Parts database, which the Shopping list reads.

DatabaseDetail.description: A database with its columns and views.

can_edit.description: False when the project is shared with you to view.

DatabaseRef.description: A database somewhere you can see, for pickers and embeds.

message.description: A sentence fit to show a person.

projects.description: Projects spawned from this one (and from those) that have parts.

title.description: A new title. Defaults to the note's.

added.description:
Added in Settings, so it can be removed there. The rest come from
the server's own addresses, `TMP_PUBLIC_URL` and `TMP_TLS_HOSTS`.

host.description: A name or IP address the certificate covers.

expires_at.description: When the generated server certificate runs out. It renews itself.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the certificate authority to trust, to compare after downloading.

port.description: The port HTTPS listens on inside the container.

attachments.description: Other files kept, such as images and PDFs.

notes.description: Markdown notes written to the vault.

renamed.description: Notes that were renamed because a note with that name already existed.

skipped.description: Entries left out: settings folders, databases (CSV), oversized files.

currency.description: ISO code for every price in Parts databases and the Shopping list.

accepted_by_name.description: Name of the person who accepted it.

image.description: The page's preview picture, an https address.

site.description: The site's own name, such as Printables.

url.description: Where the page ended up, after redirects.

LinkedRows.description: Rows of one database that link to a task.

column_id.description: The relation column that points at the task.

LockedProject.description:
A project you can't see that is linked to one you can. The canvas shows it
as a locked card, so the arrow has somewhere to go, without its title.

date.description: The day it happened, `YYYY-MM-DD`; today in your time zone when left out.

tasks_ready.description: Tasks whose last part just arrived, which got a "Parts arrived" comment.

Member.description: Someone who can see a project, and why.

share_id.description: The share to change or remove, for `project` and `account`.

via.description:
`owner`, `project` (shared directly), `account` (the owner shared
everything) or `family` (shared through a parent project).

received.description: Shares others have made with you.

tasks.description: Tasks this note is linked to, among those you can see.

NoteLink.description: Where a `[[link]]` in the note leads.

id.description: Missing when nothing has that title yet.

can_edit.description: False when it is shared with you to read only.

folder.description: First folder of the path: `Inbox`, `Knowledge`, `Projects` or another.

owner_name.description: Whose vault it is in, when that isn't yours.

path.description: Path inside the vault, such as `Knowledge/Cars/Bleeding brakes.md`.

snippet.description:
Search results only: the matching words in context, with `[` and `]`
around each hit.

can_join.description: You can say you'll join: a session someone else planned.

joined.description: You are one of the joiners.

joiners.description: People who said they'll join (sessions only), in the order they did.

occurrence.description: The local date it starts on, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Joins and skips use it.

Part.description: One row of a Parts database, read through its template columns.

can_edit.description: False when the project is shared with you to view.

qty.description: 1 when the Qty cell is empty.

stage.description:
`need`, `ordered`, `shipped`, `arrived` or `fitted`; empty when Status
is empty or set to a choice someone added.

PartTask.description: A task a part is for.

Person.description: Someone with an account on this install.

color.description: A theme slot (`slot-1` to `slot-8`) or a one-off `#rrggbb`.

cover_id.description: The photo shown on its canvas card.

role.description: What you can do with it: `owner`, `editor` or `viewer`.

parents.description: Projects this one was spawned from.

mentions.description: Other notes that mention it with `[[@Project]]`.

notes.description: Notes that list the project in their front matter.

ProjectRef.description: A parent or child, as shown in a project's breadcrumbs.

link_id.description: The link joining the two projects.

oneOf.description: With its spawned projects, when any of them have parts.

part_count.description: Parts in any Parts database of the project.

spent.description: Ordered, shipped, arrived and fitted parts.

waiting.description: The project's tasks waiting on parts.

ProjectStats.description: Numbers shown on a project's card.

last_active_at.description: Latest activity, or the last edit when there is none.

body.description: More text, such as what a share sheet sent besides the link.

text.description: The line typed (or shared). Becomes the task or note title.

url.description: A link that came with it, kept in the task's description or note's body.

column.description: The column a task went into.

note_id.description: The new note (also for the Inbox).

oneOf.description: The new task, when it was a task.

last_active_at.description: When anything last happened on it.

quiet_days.description: Days since anything happened on it.

RelationRef.description: A relation cell's link, with what's needed to show and open it.

project_id.description: Tasks and rows: the project they're in.

cover_id.description: Its first photo, for the gallery view.

file_count.description: Photos and files attached to the row.

relations.description: Relation column id to its links, in order.

values.description: Column id to value. See the column kinds for each value's shape.

groups.description: Groups moved or resized in the same drag.

nodes.description: Up to 500 cards at once, sent after a drag.

indexed.description: Files read again because they were new or had changed.

context.description: The column a task is in, a note's folder, or a row's database.

done.description: A finished task, or a project that is done or archived.

id.description: The project, task, comment, note or row id.

snippet.description: The matching words in context, with `[` and `]` around each hit.

task_id.description: The task a comment is on, or the task itself.

task_number.description: The task's number, shown as T-12.

title.description: The name to show: a title, or for a comment the words around the match.

include_children.description: Project shares: projects spawned from it come too.

include_notes.description: Account shares: knowledge notes come too, not only project notes.

arrived.description: Parts that arrived this month, newest first.

date.description: Today in the viewer's time zone, `YYYY-MM-DD`, for "Mark ordered".

need.description: Parts in Need, by supplier, biggest spend first and no supplier last.

on_the_way.description: Ordered and Shipped parts, by supplier.

ShoppingSummary.description: How much there is to buy, for the Today screen.

supplier.description: As first written; empty for parts with no supplier.

assignee_id.description: Who is doing it, someone the project is shared with.

attachment_count.description: Photos and files on it, its comments' included.

note_count.description: Notes linked to the task, including any not shared with you.

overdue.description: Open, with a due date before today.

parts_total.description: Parts (rows of Parts databases) for this task.

parts_waiting.description: Of those, the ones not arrived or fitted yet.

status_name.description: The column's name, such as Doing.

attachments.description:
Photos and files on the task itself, oldest first. Those added with a
comment are on the comment.

hidden_notes.description: Linked notes that aren't shared with you.

notes.description: Linked notes you can read, most recently updated first.

date.description: Today in the viewer's time zone, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

due.description: Open tasks due in the next 7 days, and late ones, soonest first.

inbox.description: Quick captures not filed under a project yet, newest first.

quiet.description: Your active projects with no activity for 14 days, quietest first.

sessions.description: Today's work sessions: yours and those you're joining.

shopping.description: Parts to buy across your projects, for the Shopping list link.

caption.description: A few words under the photo. Empty clears it.

kind.description: Change the type. Values are converted where they can be, else cleared.

after_id.description: Put it after this database, or first when `null`.

UpdateEventRequest.description:
Fields left out stay as they are; `null` clears `title` or `repeat_until`.
Changes to a repeating event apply to every week.

project_id.description: Move a session to another project you can edit.

UpdateNoteRequest.description: Fields left out stay as they are.

folder.description: Moves the file to this folder.

title.description: Renames the file and updates links to it in other notes.

UpdateProjectRequest.description: Fields left out stay as they are. Send `null` to clear an optional field.

status.description: Setting `archived` stamps `archived_at`; any other status clears it.

relations.description: Replaces the links of each relation column named.

values.description: Only the columns named change; `null` clears a cell.

after_id.description: Move the column: put it after this column, or first when `null`.

UpdateTaskRequest.description: Fields left out stay as they are. Send `null` to clear an optional field.

after_id.description:
Place the card after this task in its column, or at the top when `null`.
Left out, a moved card goes to the bottom and an unmoved one stays put.

assignee_id.description: Someone who can see the project, or `null` for nobody.

category.description:
Move to the first column of this category, as the global board does.
Adds the column if the project has none.

file.description: One or more files, each in a part named `file`.

role.description: `owner` (the account that set up the install) or `member`.

check_enabled.description: False when `TMP_UPDATE_CHECK` turns the check off.

development_build.description: True when this server wasn't built from a release tag, so there is nothing to compare.

error.description: Why the last check failed, if it did.

oneOf.description: The newest release GitHub knows of, once a check has worked.

kind.description: `table`, `board`, `calendar` or `gallery` (cards with each row's first photo).
